statement: AMD reported Q2 2026 GAAP gross margin of 54% (non-GAAP 56%).
why: Vendor gross margin shows how much pricing power the accelerator supplier holds, which is a read on whether demand outruns available supply.

impact.mechanism: Margin achieved alongside record revenue and profitability indicates the vendor is not discounting to move accelerator volume.

evidence.excerpt: gross margin 54%, operating income $2.0 billion, net income $2.3 billion, diluted EPS $1.38; non-GAAP gross margin 56%

confidence.basis: Figures from AMD's own earnings release with companion 8-K, primary issuer disclosure.
